cause: The 30-second exec call returned a still-running pytest session, but the orchestration projection emitted only exit_code and output and omitted the session_id. The visible progress ended at 66 percent plus a partial line and is not a completion receipt.

followup_process_check.interpretation: The child had ended before the follow-up, but its terminal exit code and tail were unavailable; no pass or fail conclusion is inferred.

recovery: Rerun the exact cross-stage scope and preserve the complete exec result object; if a session_id is returned, resume it with write_stdin until a terminal exit code is observed.
